Sum endpoint marginals before charging and use domination by original volume with the whole own fiber removed. This makes the own-fiber contribution and outside charge additive.
The aggregate midpoint measure has mass sum_j m_j and exactly the required density ceiling on K. The ordinary weight-two theorem applies to its actual weighted centroid.

The ordinary theorem's surplus is positive and independent of cap orientation. A pure-base cap through or containing the mark includes the whole own fiber and the whole midpoint target trace, giving its own positive uniform surplus before taking the infimum.
Source 0915985a8bcdfd44 §7 (11)–(12) specifies both the global outside-source budget and the single shared midpoint ceiling. Individual domination is insufficient.
